rationale: The original short premise relied on price holding below the 5-minute 9-EMA ($17.93 at entry, now $17.96), yet SA has broken and held above this level for three consecutive minutes following entry. With the ask currently resting at the $18.08 invalidation level and a wide 22.1 bps spread ($18.04 x $18.08), initiating an exit now allows the order to attempt working passively near the bid rather than waiting for an immediate market stop-out across the spread.
